FIFA President Infantino faces scrutiny over Trump ties and player ban reversal

FIFA President Gianni Infantino is facing scrutiny following the reversal of a red card suspension for US player Folarin Balogun. European lawmakers have called for an investigation into Infantino's conduct, citing potential intervention by Donald Trump. The controversy has led to backlash against FIFA and its president, with accusations of hypocrisy and undue influence.
